unlisted_practices: Embed AI into medical education as a scaffold for reasoning, prompting learners to articulate hypotheses, test alternatives, and confront biases.
Balance AI use in medical education with mandatory non-AI problem-solving sessions.
Mandate local calibration studies of AI tools.
Define AI-free phases in patient consultations to preserve human connection.
Emphasize clinical observation training and delay AI consultation until after initial clinician assessment.
Cultivate clinician metacognitive habits to question and refine AI outputs.
Integrate AI tools with electronic health records to enable continuity-aware insights.
Pair AI recommendations in ethically sensitive decisions with shared decision-making tools and explicit human oversight.
Develop regulatory frameworks that adapt alongside evolving AI models.
